The compact and scalable propulsion system is seen as a significant step in the development of affordable hypersonic capabilities for defense applications.
feed.title: GE Aerospace and Lockheed Martin test new rotating detonation ramjet for hypersonic weapons

feed.summary: Eight parts suppliers for Korea Electric Power (KEPCO) and eleven of their employees have been indicted for bid rigging worth approximately 670 billion won ($454 million). The companies are accused of colluding to set bid prices and select winners in 145 KEPCO bids for gas insulated switchgear between 2015 and 2022, allegedly earning at least 160 billion won in illicit profits. Prosecutors believe this bid rigging led to increased electricity bills for the public.

feed.summary: The article details the critical role of Boeing's four 747-400 Large Cargo Freighters, known as Dreamlifters, in supporting the global manufacturing network of the 787 Dreamliner. In 2025, one Dreamlifter (N747BC) completed 175 flights, often performing multiple sorties daily to transport oversized components like wings and fuselage sections from partners in Japan and Italy to the final assembly line in Charleston, South Carolina. These specialized aircraft significantly reduce transit times, enabling the efficient production of the 787 Dreamliner.
